eventStreams.name: GuestMovements
eventStreams.description: Real-time guest check-in, check-out, and room change events
kqlAggregations: GuestMovementEvents | summarize CheckIns=countif(EventType=='CheckIn'), CheckOuts=countif(EventType=='CheckOut'), RoomChanges=countif(EventType=='RoomChange') by PropertyID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
GuestMovementEvents | summarize CurrentOccupancy=dcountif(GuestID, EventType=='CheckIn') - dcountif(GuestID, EventType=='CheckOut') by PropertyID, bin(Timestamp, 15m)

eventStreams.name: PropertyTelemetry
eventStreams.description: HVAC, energy consumption, and water usage telemetry from properties
kqlAggregations: PropertyTelemetryEvents | summarize AvgValue=avg(Value), MaxValue=max(Value), AlarmCount=countif(IsAlarm) by PropertyID, SensorType, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
PropertyTelemetryEvents | where SensorType=='Energy' | summarize TotalKWh=sum(Value) by PropertyID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: ActivityEvents
eventStreams.description: Adventure activity bookings, completions, and safety incidents
kqlAggregations: ActivityStreamEvents | summarize Bookings=countif(EventType=='Booking'), Completions=countif(EventType=='Completed'), Incidents=countif(EventType=='Incident') by PropertyID, ActivityTypeID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
ActivityStreamEvents | where Severity in ('Critical','High') | summarize IncidentCount=count() by PropertyID, ActivityTypeID, bin(Timestamp, 15m)

bridgeQueries.name: OccupancyBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge real-time guest movements with cold reservation data

bridgeQueries.name: EnergyBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge property telemetry with cold energy usage data
